description: This file represents the main page component of a React-based front-end application for a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It imports various UI components and hooks, and renders the game interface including header, mode switcher, controls, status bar, and game board. It orchestrates the overall layout and passes state and actions to child components.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: React functional component that renders the main page of the Tic-Tac-Toe web app, utilizing various UI components and custom hook to manage state and actions.
